subject: Security & compliance follow-up — pen test report request + vuln ops plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bayshorehealth.com>; Bayshore Security Team <security@bayshorehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security & compliance follow-up — pen test report request + vuln ops plan

Hi Liam / Bayshore security team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — really appreciated the open discussion about integration points and PHI flow for the CareCoord product. Quick recap from our side and a proposed path forward so we can keep the integration and procurement moving: 

Call recap (high level)
- Primary integration: S3-backed artifact ingestion + streaming inference to support summaries.
- Data classification: customer data includes PHI (HIPAA scope).
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II status, evidence for HIPAA controls, and your pen test cadence.

What we need (next steps)
1) SOC 2: Please share the SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 summary (redacted is fine).
2) Pen test: If you have a pen test report within the last 12 months, please provide a redacted PDF. If not, confirm a planned test window and scope so we can align our intake.
3) Vulnerability program: A short description or export of your vuln tracker + typical SLA for severity levels (Critical/High/Medium/Low).
4) Dataflow: A network or dataflow diagram that shows where PHI is stored/processed.
5) Vendor questionnaire: We will send a short vendor security questionnaire (10–12 qs) — please assign a primary point of contact.

Operational preferences from Redwood
- Pen test evidence: acceptable as a redacted report or a signed attestation from your security vendor listing findings + remediation status.
- Remediation expectations (for integrations handling PHI): recommended SLA: Critical=7 days, High=30 days, Medium=90 days; we can be flexible depending on severity and compensating controls.
- Scanning cadence we recommend: weekly internal authenticated scans, monthly external scans, plus annual or major-release pentest.

Proposed next actions
- Please reply with SOC2/pen test artifacts or a date range when the test will occur.
- I'll follow up with a short vendor questionnaire (will come from security@redwood.com) — can you confirm the best contact?
- If helpful, Neha from our security team can run a 30-min intake meeting to align scope and the disclosure process.

Thanks — looping in Marissa for onboarding timeline and Rachel for any legal redline questions on the MSA.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

Subject: Re: Security & compliance follow-up — pen test report request + vuln ops plan

Hi Liam / Ellen — thanks for sending the initial artifacts. I reviewed the SOC2 summary and the redacted pentest and have a couple of clarifying asks so we can complete our security intake quickly: 

Required artifacts for Redwood onboarding (short list)
- Full SOC 2 Type II report OR an auditor-signed summary plus the control matrix (redactions allowed).
- Pen test report (redacted ok) + remediation closure evidence (ticket exports or signed attestation from vendor).
- Export of your vuln tracker for the last 12 months (CSV or PDF) showing severity, open/closed status, and remediation ETA.
- Dataflow/architecture diagram showing PHI boundaries and any tokenization/encryption points.
- If you run authenticated scans: sample scan report and credentials model (service account vs. per-app creds).

Clarifications and preferences
- Redaction policy: redactions that remove PII are fine; we need consistent issue IDs so we can map findings to remediation evidence.
- Disclosure policy: we require a coordinated disclosure window (minimum 14 days) for any active exploitation-related findings that could impact our customers. Please let us know if you have a differing policy.
- Remediation SLAs: your internal SLA looks good (Critical=5 business days). For our contractual language we usually reference calendar days; Rachel (cc'd) can confirm precise wording.

Scheduling
- I propose a 30-minute intake on Friday 18 Jun at 09:30 PT to walk through scope and evidence exchange. Please confirm or propose an alternative.

If you prefer, I can send the vendor questionnaire now and Ellen can return answers inline — that often speeds things up.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
